name: Fukuoka
tagline: Ramen stalls and an easy-going port city
summary: Kyushu's biggest city is about eating: tonkotsu ramen, open-air yatai stalls and seafood. Sights are few and close together, and Dazaifu's shrine is a half-day trip.
seasonNote: Summer is hot and humid; the Hakata Gion Yamakasa festival runs in early July.
arrival: The airport is five minutes by subway from Hakata Station.
gettingAround: The subway links the airport, Hakata and Tenjin; most of the centre is walkable.
cashTip: Bring cash for yatai stalls, which rarely take cards.
foodTip: Try Hakata tonkotsu ramen, mentaiko (spicy cod roe), motsunabe offal hotpot and mizutaki chicken hotpot.
buyTip: Mentaiko to take home (chilled), Hakata dolls and Hakata-ori woven textiles.

connections.note: High-speed ferry; flights take under an hour.

items.tip: Try a grilled umegae mochi on the approach and see the Kengo Kuma-designed café.
